verdict.rationale: Entra ID is an identity SaaS platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis to judge. The only MCP evidence is a probe pointing to a Microsoft Learn training/support MCP page. That is a documentation-platform (host) server, not an Entra ID MCP server that lets an agent operate the directory. Graph API, metadata and Graph Explorer are developer building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
